patch_resolves_note: The fixed source adds a UTF-8 guard before returning the RC4-decrypted buffer as an XPath string. On the original PoC that guard suppresses return_wrapped_string; the adjacent one-byte ciphertext mutation `first_cipher_byte_8f_empty_utf8` shows the same protected return executes on the fixed side only when xmlCheckUTF8(ret) is true.

root_cause_criterion.obligation: Before exsltCryptoRc4DecryptFunction returns `ret` through xmlXPathReturnString(ctxt, ret), the decrypted buffer must satisfy xmlCheckUTF8(ret) != 0.
root_cause_criterion.fix_mechanism: The fixed source evaluates xmlCheckUTF8(ret) at the return site and substitutes xmlXPathReturnEmptyString(ctxt) for invalid decrypted output instead of returning the raw buffer.
root_cause_criterion.verification_note: In the vulnerable original case, ret_utf8_guard.utf8_valid=0 and return_wrapped_string still executes, violating the required predicate. In the fixed original case the predicate stays false but return_wrapped_string is absent (guarded). The adjacent case `first_cipher_byte_8f_empty_utf8` makes xmlCheckUTF8(ret)=1 and executes return_wrapped_string on the fixed side, giving the required genuine witness.

nodes.description: At the `*prefix++` sink in the prefix-emission loop, the final vulnerable read attempt spans 32 bytes from the original format pointer while the decrypted string only has 31 bytes of storage including its NUL terminator, so the loop dereferences the first byte past the heap allocation.
nodes.evidence: The last vulnerable original prefix_emit_window event records prefix_length=32 and format_storage_bytes=31.

edges.description: When exsltCryptoRc4DecryptFunction returns the decrypted buffer through xmlXPathReturnString(ctxt, ret), the same heap pointer becomes the caller's formatObj->stringval argument for format-number().
edges.evidence: The vulnerable original trace records return_wrapped_string.ret_ptr == format_number_call.format_string_ptr == 0x603000001240.

edges.description: The same format string pointer passed from xsltFormatNumberFunction is received unchanged as the `format` parameter used by the later prefix-emission read attempts in xsltFormatNumberConversion.
edges.evidence: The vulnerable original trace records format_number_call.format_string_ptr == prefix_emit_window.prefix_ptr == 0x603000001240 on the first subsequent prefix-emission event.
